headword: {和洋折衷|わようせっちゅう}
gloss: blending of Japanese and Western styles

definitions.gloss: blending of Japanese and Western styles; Japanese-Western fusion
definitions.explanation: The combination or harmonizing of Japanese (和) and Western (洋) elements in architecture, food, fashion, or culture. A concept deeply rooted in Japan's history of cultural adaptation since the Meiji era.

examples.japanese: この{建物|たてもの}は{和洋折衷|わようせっちゅう}のデザインだ。
examples.english: This building has a Japanese-Western fusion design.

examples.japanese: {和洋折衷|わようせっちゅう}の{料理|りょうり}が{人気|にんき}を{集|あつ}めている。
examples.english: Japanese-Western fusion cuisine is gaining popularity.

examples.japanese: {明治時代|めいじじだい}には{和洋折衷|わようせっちゅう}の{生活様式|せいかつようしき}が{広|ひろ}まった。
examples.english: During the Meiji era, a blended Japanese-Western lifestyle became widespread.

notes:
USAGE:
A four-character compound ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}) made up of {和|わ} (Japanese), {洋|よう} (Western), {折|せっ} (blending), and {衷|ちゅう} (middle/compromise). Used to describe anything that combines Japanese and Western elements, from architecture and interior design to food and fashion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {和洋折衷|わようせっちゅう}の{建物|たてもの} (Japanese-Western style building)
- {和洋折衷|わようせっちゅう}の{料理|りょうり} (fusion cuisine)
- {和洋折衷|わようせっちゅう}のスタイル (blended style)
- {和洋折衷|わようせっちゅう}の{住宅|じゅうたく} (Japanese-Western style house)

RELATED WORDS:
- {和風|わふう}: Japanese style
- {洋風|ようふう}: Western style
- {折衷|せっちゅう}: compromise, blending — the general term for combining two things
